Deadlines
Fall and Summer Application Deadline: January 8 (priority for assistantships and scholarships)
Spring Application Deadline: October 1 (assistantships and scholarships not normally awarded for spring admission)
Required Documents
Personal Statement
Resume or CV
3 Letters of Recommendation (from faculty or other professionals in the field)
Official TOEFL or IELTS score (if applicable)
Official Transcripts:
Undergraduate Transcripts
